title: MTHFR 677C->T genotype is associated with folate and homocysteine concentrations in a large, population-based, double-blind trial of folic acid supplementation
authors: Crider KS, Zhu JH, Hao L, Yang QH, Yang TP, Gindler J, et al.
followUp: 6 months of supplementation and 3 months after stopping
population: Women of childbearing age in northern China randomised to folic acid 100, 400 or 4000 µg daily or 4000 µg weekly; genotyped subset
funder: Supported by a cooperative agreement with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
result: Results read from the published abstract. Plasma and red cell folate and plasma homocysteine were associated with MTHFR 677C>T genotype throughout supplementation regardless of dose; TT carriers had lower folate concentrations, and TT < CC persisted at the highest doses. Folic acid 100 µg daily or 4000 µg weekly did not reduce high homocysteine in TT carriers. Genotype did not interact significantly with folic acid dose.
